title: Man shot by Edmonton officer was carrying rifle, police say
subtitle: Alberta Serious Incident Response Team has taken over investigation
article: A man wounded by an Edmonton police officer early Sunday came out of a house carrying a rifle moments before he was shot, police say.
Officers were called to a house near 85th Avenue and 149th Street around 4 a.m. after police got a 911 call about a man who was threatening to shoot himself.
When officers arrived, police say a man carrying a long-barreled weapon came outside and c onfronted them.
One officer fired his service weapon and the man was wounded.
The 50-year-old is now in hospital with serious, non-life threatening injuries.
